title: Quant research signal; no trading action or probability claim
description: Cross-field time ordering and complete-universe coverage are additionally enforced by quant.inference.

predicted_target_percentile.description: Model estimate of a future target percentile. Not P(up), P(outperform) or a calibrated probability.

cross_sectional_model_rank.description: Average-tie percentile (rank-1)/(N-1) of model scores in the complete declared daily universe.

model_version.description: Content-derived identifier of the frozen model artifact, which carries its own training data identity and cutoff.

inference_input_id.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of that scoring time's complete feature panel: keys, feature values, data cutoffs and row provenance. It binds no label, outcome, fold or other scoring date.

training_cutoff.description: Latest information availability of training outcomes, not merely the last training feature date.
